title: Online Continual Learning on Intel Loihi 2 via a Co-designed Spiking Neural Network
abstract: arXiv:2511.01553v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Edge AI must adapt to new classes and shifting data within a tight power budget, but online continual learning (learning from each sample before the next arrives) is where conventional processors are least efficient: each small update pays a full dispatch at full power. We present CLP-SNN, a spiking architecture that recasts the Continually Learning Prototypes (CLP) algorithm as event-driven neural dynamics: a self-normalizing local rule replaces CLP's global renormalization, prototype allocation becomes novelty-triggered neurogenesis, and correctness-modulated plasticity becomes reward-gated per-neuron metaplasticity. Deployed on Intel Loihi 2 as the first online continual learner on that chip, rehearsal-free CLP-SNN matches Replay and SLDA on OpenLORIS at 1-shot; at 25-shot, it stays within 0.8 percentage points of Replay and 6.2 points below covariance-based SLDA. translated_title: 通过协同设计的脉冲神经网络在Intel Loihi 2上实现在线持续学习
translated_abstract: 边缘AI必须在严格的功耗预算内适应新类别和不断变化的数据，但在线持续学习（在下一个样本到来之前从每个样本中学习）恰恰是传统处理器效率最低的场景：每次小规模更新都需要以全功率支付完整的调度开销。我们提出了CLP-SNN，这是一种脉冲神经网络架构，它将持续学习原型算法重新构建为事件驱动的神经动力学：一个自归一化的局部规则取代了CLP的全局重新归一化，原型分配变为由新颖性触发的神经发生，正确性调节的可塑性变为奖励门控的每神经元元可塑性。作为该芯片上的首个在线持续学习器，CLP-SNN被部署在Intel Loihi 2上。在OpenLORIS数据集上，无需回放的CLP-SNN在1-shot设置下与Replay和SLDA性能相当；在25-shot设置下，它与Replay的差距在0.8个百分点以内，比基于协方差的SLDA低6.2个百分点。在提取的特征上，每个预测与更新步骤……（摘要截断）
tldr: 提出CLP-SNN，一种将持续学习原型（CLP）算法重构为事件驱动神经动力学的协同设计脉冲神经网络，并作为首个在线持续学习器部署于Intel Loihi 2芯片，在低功耗约束下于OpenLORIS上取得与Replay和SLDA相当的性能。
en_tdlr: CLP-SNN co-designs a spiking neural network that recasts the Continually Learning Prototypes algorithm as event-driven neural dynamics, and becomes the first online continual learner deployed on Intel Loihi 2, matching Replay and SLDA on OpenLORIS under tight power budgets.
